## berth pkg add

add packages and build the org's image

### Synopsis

add packages and build the org's image

Docs: https://ar4mirez.github.io/berth/reference/commands/berth_pkg_add/

```
berth pkg add <org> <package|@preset>... [--no-build] [flags]
```

### Examples

```
  berth pkg add acme libpq-dev
  berth pkg add acme @playwright-chromium
  berth restart acme   # to run on the new image
```

```
  -h, --help   help for add
```
